solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Officials showing excessive charm with female stars around

indicators.note: the female and the stars sit on either side of the charm, so they go around it

parts.note: Aries is a constellation and star sign, the Ram
unction is an oily, overdone show of earnestness or charm

explanation.surface: Some officials are flattering their leading ladies with oily charm.
explanation.definitionFit: Functionaries are people holding official posts, especially minor bureaucrats.

clue.text: How to make Elba popular

parts.note: to fashion is to make, and ABLE rearranged makes ELBA

explanation.surface: Instructions for turning Napoleon's island of exile into a hot spot.
explanation.walkthrough: Read the answer as two words: FASHION, a verb meaning shape, and ABLE, whose letters can be shaped into ELBA.
explanation.definitionFit: Fashionable means in vogue, liked and followed by many people.

clue.text: Managed to conceal identity, on the way up from rock bottom

indicators.note: in a down clue, going up means the letters are read from the bottom, i.e. backwards
the word for managed hides the identity abbreviation inside it

parts.note: to run something is to manage it; the past tense is used
ID is short for identity, as on an ID card

explanation.surface: Someone hiding who they are as they climb out of the lowest point of their life.
explanation.definitionFit: The nadir is the lowest point of anything, an idiom matching rock bottom.

clue.text: Kind to bag excellent 50? That's more than is expected of me!

definitions.text: That's more than is expected of me!

indicators.note: to bag is to capture or pocket, so the kind word holds the other pieces

parts.note: tender means gentle and kind
A1 means first-rate; crosswords often write the 1 as the letter I
L is the Roman numeral for fifty

explanation.surface: A cricketer near the bottom of the batting order, thrilled to score a half-century, exclaims how unexpected it is.
explanation.walkthrough: In cricket the tailenders are the weak batsmen at the end of the order; a score of 50 from one is a surprise. AI stands for A1, meaning excellent.
explanation.definitionFit: A tailender is a low-order batsman, from whom a half-century score is far beyond normal expectation.

clue.text: Sporting hit in area at front of house?

parts.note: on can mean in, as in being on or in a team
a drive is the private road or paved area in front of a house

explanation.surface: A question of whether a ball was struck into someone's front garden.
explanation.walkthrough: An on-drive is a cricket stroke: a straight-batted shot played to the leg side of the bowler.
explanation.definitionFit: The on-drive is a batting stroke in cricket, so it is a hit in a sport.

clue.text: Naomi's tricky medical procedure

indicators.note: something tricky is awkward or intricate, so the name's letters are tangled

parts.note: the name is the fodder; the apostrophe-s reads as 'is', linking it to the anagram signal

explanation.surface: A woman named Naomi is facing a difficult hospital test.
explanation.definitionFit: Amnio is short for amniocentesis, a test sampling the fluid around a fetus.

clue.text: Thereby, one understanding nothing must keep quiet mostly

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral one

indicators.note: to keep something is to hold it within, so the outer pieces enclose the quiet word

parts.note: a pact is an agreement or understanding

indicators.note: most of the word is kept, its last letter dropped

parts.note: soft means quiet
O looks like zero

explanation.surface: Someone who grasps nothing had better keep fairly quiet, and so it follows.
explanation.walkthrough: The quiet word, short of its last letter, sits after the first two letters of the agreement.
explanation.definitionFit: Ipso facto is Latin for 'by that very fact', which is what thereby expresses.

clue.text: Prophet with small house disappearing in water

indicators.note: the short house vanishes from the prophet's name

parts.note: Hosea is a minor prophet of the Old Testament
Ho is the abbreviation of house, as in addresses

explanation.surface: A prophet watches a little dwelling vanish into a flood.
explanation.definitionFit: The sea is the great body of salt water covering much of the earth.

clue.text: One in charge of NY paper, say, lacking freshness?

parts.note: New York is an example of something American, which the 'say' signals
an editor is in charge of a paper; ED is the short form

explanation.surface: A question about the editor of a New York newspaper being stale.
explanation.walkthrough: Read as one in charge of a US paper: an American editor. The question mark flags that playful split.
explanation.definitionFit: Used goods are second-hand, no longer new or fresh.

clue.text: Asian individuals tucked into curry maybe?

indicators.note: the individuals are placed inside the curry word, as food tucked into

parts.note: an Indian is a curry meal in British slang; 'maybe' flags the example
ones are single items or individuals

explanation.surface: Diners from Asia tucking into a curry.
explanation.walkthrough: In Britain 'going for an Indian' means eating out at an Indian restaurant, so curry is an example of an Indian.
explanation.definitionFit: Indonesians come from Indonesia, a country of south-east Asia, so the nationality is an Asian one.

clue.text: Former PM to show lack of respect for artist and priest

parts.note: to dis someone is to disrespect them
RA is a Royal Academician
Eli is the priest in the Old Testament who raised Samuel

explanation.surface: An old prime minister snubbing a painter and a clergyman.
explanation.definitionFit: Benjamin Disraeli was twice British Prime Minister in the nineteenth century.

clue.text: Agency no longer in a slippery situation?

parts.note: off means out, as of a dish no longer on the menu
ice is literally slippery ground

explanation.surface: An agency asks whether it is out of a precarious spot.
explanation.definitionFit: Office can mean an agency or department of government, such as a passport office.

clue.text: Protection ahead of assault means an additional expense

indicators.note: in a down clue the first piece sits above, ahead of, the second

parts.note: cover is shelter or protection
a charge is a rushing attack

explanation.surface: Armour before an attack means more spending.
explanation.definitionFit: A cover charge is an extra fee added to a restaurant or club bill per customer.

clue.text: Comment critically, notice given after a game

indicators.note: the notice comes after the other pieces

parts.note: the clue's a is kept as the letter A
nim is a game of taking objects from heaps
an advert is a notice publicising something

explanation.surface: Criticism posted on a noticeboard after a match.
explanation.definitionFit: To animadvert is a formal verb for passing censure or criticism on something.

clue.text: Fellow standing on court outside hotel somewhere in China

indicators.note: in a down clue the fellow stands on top of what follows

parts.note: man is a fellow, a chap

indicators.note: the court goes around the hotel letter

parts.note: a curia is a court, as in the papal Curia

explanation.surface: A man standing in a courtyard outside a Chinese hotel.
explanation.definitionFit: Manchuria is a historical region of north-east China.

clue.text: Diseased tree to get rid of — most of the tree

indicators.note: something diseased is disordered, so the first tree's letters are rearranged

parts.note: the first tree supplies the letters to be rearranged
to bin something is to throw it away

indicators.note: most of the little word is kept, its last letter dropped

parts.note: the word the, cut short, supplies two letters

explanation.surface: A sick tree to be thrown out, or most of it.
explanation.walkthrough: The first 'tree' is anagram fodder, the second is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: The terebinth is a Mediterranean species of small pistachio, a source of turpentine.

clue.text: Not half incautious, producing alcoholic drink

indicators.note: only the first half of the word is kept

parts.note: cavalier means offhand and careless of consequences

explanation.surface: A tipple that makes you rather less than reckless.
explanation.definitionFit: Cava is a Spanish sparkling wine, so it is an alcoholic drink.

clue.text: Old bar providing port

parts.note: to bar is to forbid or ban

explanation.surface: An old pub supplies a fortified wine.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Port' looks like the drink served in the old bar; it is a harbour town.
explanation.definitionFit: Oban is a ferry port on the west coast of Scotland.

clue.text: Agent tore around with anger. presenting a range of items

parts.note: a rep is a sales representative or agent

indicators.note: the letters of tore are turned around into a different order

parts.note: the word tore supplies the letters to be rearranged
ire is anger

explanation.surface: A sales agent rushed about in a temper.
explanation.definitionFit: A repertoire is the stock of pieces or skills a performer can present.

clue.text: A Welsh female maybe "catty" in a certain way?

parts.note: per means 'a', as in ten pounds a head
Sian is a common Welsh woman's name; 'maybe' marks the example

explanation.surface: Wondering whether a woman from Wales is being spiteful.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Catty' looks like spiteful; read literally it means cat-like, and the answer is a breed of cat.
explanation.definitionFit: A Persian is a long-haired breed of domestic cat, so it is literally feline.

clue.text: Endless ordeal involving your old heavenly body

indicators.note: to involve is to include or wrap in, so the short ordeal holds the old word
the ordeal word loses its final letter

parts.note: a test is a trial or ordeal
thy is the archaic form of your

explanation.surface: An ordeal that never ends is wrapped up in your former romantic partner.
explanation.definitionFit: Tethys is one of Saturn's moons, an astronomical object in the sky.

clue.text: Suggestion of story comes to writer in hut

indicators.note: only a hint of the word is given, its first letter

parts.note: the word story supplies its opening letter
a hack is a jobbing journalist or writer

explanation.surface: A writer in a hut gets the germ of a story.
explanation.definitionFit: A shack is a roughly built small cabin.

clue.text: Mistake wearing gem that's only cheap paste?

indicators.note: the gem has the mistake on, so it goes around it

parts.note: a ruby is a red gemstone
bish is British slang for a blunder

explanation.surface: A blunder over a jewel which turns out to be fake.
explanation.walkthrough: Paste is glass made to imitate gems, so a sham jewel is worthless.
explanation.definitionFit: Rubbishy means worthless and of poor quality, as imitation jewellery is.

clue.text: A combination of elements making Scott's hero abandon his lake

indicators.note: the hero gives up part of his name

parts.note: young Lochinvar is the dashing hero of a ballad in Walter Scott's poem Marmion
loch is the Scottish word for lake, and it starts the hero's name

explanation.surface: A recipe of ingredients forcing a novelist's champion to leave his water.
explanation.definitionFit: Invar is an alloy of iron and nickel, and an alloy mixes metals.

clue.text: US President getting little right, helping to create anomaly

parts.note: Abe is Abraham Lincoln
R is the short form of right
a ration is a portion or helping

explanation.surface: A US president earning little praise for his help produces something odd.
explanation.definitionFit: An aberration is a departure from what is normal, an oddity.

clue.text: Vessel surfacing? One is designed to carry passengers

definitions.text: One is designed to carry passengers

indicators.note: in a down clue the vessel comes up, so its letters read upwards

parts.note: a sub is a submarine

explanation.surface: A submarine rises; is it built for passengers?
explanation.definitionFit: A bus is a road vehicle built to carry passengers.

clue.text: Short note written about part of speech

indicators.note: turned about, the note is read backwards
the note is cut short, losing its last letter

parts.note: a breve is a long musical note

explanation.surface: A brief memo written concerning a grammar lesson.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Short note' looks like a memo; it is a musical note, the breve, docked.
explanation.definitionFit: A verb is a word class expressing actions or states.

clue.text: Candidate finally finishes speaking with husky voice in the auditorium

indicators.note: only the last letter of the word is used

parts.note: the word finishes supplies its closing letter
talking is speaking

indicators.note: what an audience hears in a hall is the sound, so the husky word is replaced by its sound-alike

parts.note: hoarse means husky or rough-voiced

explanation.surface: A political candidate ends a speech croakily in a hall.
explanation.walkthrough: A stalking horse is a candidate standing only to test support or split the vote for someone else.
explanation.definitionFit: In politics a stalking horse is a front-runner put forward to mask another contender's plans.
